Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified Princess Margaretha of Saxony’s mother by confusing two different royals with similar names (the 1840–1858 Princess Margaretha vs. the 1900–1962 Princess Margarete). Despite the initial search result clearly stating that the 1840 Princess Margaretha’s mother was Princess Amalie Auguste of Bavaria, the Planner incorrectly concluded it was Archduchess Luise of Austria-Tuscany. This genealogical misinterpretation led the workflow to pursue the wrong individual and birthplace (Salzburg) instead of the correct mother’s birthplace (Munich), and the error propagated through subsequent steps.
